# Shri Vishwawedhika Ayurvedic Center & Panchakarma Garbha Sanskar Center

> Authentic classical Ayurvedic clinic, traditional Panchakarma detoxification, and Garbha Sanskar prenatal center in Kharadi, Pune, Maharashtra. Supervised by Dr. Manjiri with personalized holistic treatments and 100% natural herbal therapies.

## Core Treatments & Specializations
- **Panchakarma Detoxification:** Authentic five-fold classical cleansing (Vamana, Virechana, Basti, Nasya, Raktamokshana) for complete metabolic rejuvenation.
- **Stroke Rehabilitation & Neurological Care:** Multi-disciplinary Ayurvedic recovery protocols combining Shirodhara, Tailadhara, Njavarakizhi, and functional physical rehabilitation.
- **Spine & Chronic Back Pain Care:** Non-surgical treatment for slip disc, sciatica, lumbar spondylosis, and postural stiffness using Kati Basti and medicated herbal fomentation.
- **Physiotherapy & Integrated Rehab:** Blending modern biomechanics, manual mobilization, and warm classical medicated oils.
- **Pediatric Cerebral Palsy Care:** Gentle neuroplasticity enhancement with Medhya Ghritam, sensory stimulation, and parent-guided home care routines.
- **Eye Care (Netra Chikitsa):** Netra Tarpana therapies for computer vision syndrome, dry eyes, and ocular strain.
- **Infertility & Garbha Sanskar:** Classical Uttar Basti, hormonal rebalancing, and wholesome prenatal care for couples planning for parenthood.
- **Skin & Hair Treatments:** Root-cause metabolic purification for psoriasis, eczema, alopecia, and chronic acne.
- **Stress & Rejuvenation (Rasayana):** Authentic Shirodhara and herbal therapies for chronic insomnia, anxiety, and mental clarity.
